# NeatEditor 1.0.18
### Changed
- Replace the full-width editor status bar with a non-interactive floating character count; keep the final text line clear of the count and preserve the full-height line-number gutter. - Count committed characters off the main actor, including spaces, line breaks and composed emoji, and expose the visible count to accessibility. - Separate sidebar file discovery, bounded previews and legacy migration from core document persistence, and share collision-safe naming across first saves and file duplication. - Adopt the approved blue rolled-paper app icon with a serif N, its lower third hidden behind the roller.
### Fixed
- Keep legacy document migration retryable when a file copy fails instead of marking an incomplete migration finished. Preserve existing destination files and legacy originals. - Add regression coverage for numbered copies, extensionless and Unicode filenames, bounded collision retries and immediate propagation of non-collision errors. - Refuse dirty release checkouts instead of automatically committing another session's unfinished work.
### 简体中文
- 将编辑器整行状态栏改为不可交互的悬浮字数显示；为末行文字保留空间，行号栏仍保持全高。 - 在主线程之外统计已上屏的字符，包含空格、换行和组合表情，并向辅助功能提供当前可见的字数。 - 将侧边栏文件发现、有界预览和旧文档迁移从核心持久化逻辑拆分，首次保存与文件复制共用防覆盖的重名处理。 - 采用已确认的蓝底卷纸图标，纸面为衬线 N，字母下方三分之一由滚轴遮挡。 - 修复文件复制失败后旧文档迁移仍被标记为完成的问题，允许后续重试，同时保留目标目录已有文件和旧目录原件。 - 增加编号副本、无扩展名及中文文件名、重名重试上限和非重名错误立即返回的回归测试。 - 发布时拒绝包含未提交改动的工作区，不再自动提交其他会话尚未完成的工作。

# NeatEditor 1.0.16
### Changed
- Use one native compact 40 pt top row, keeping the sidebar toggle beside the window controls and New Document and Always on Top aligned with the document tabs. - Reduce document tabs to equal 168 pt slots with 30 pt height, 13 pt regular titles and a lighter separator outline, preserving their stepped join to the editor. - Move documents-folder selection into Settings and remove the sidebar header's folder actions menu. - Give sidebar files consistent row heights and keep the selected tab and its connected content surface the same color.
### Fixed
- Repair editor rendering with TextKit 2 so inserting and deleting text no longer leaves stale line fragments; keep wrapped-line numbers, the final line and search highlights aligned with the displayed text. - Keep the tab strip's available width synchronized with window resizing so widening the window reveals tabs instead of leaving unused space. - Let blank top-row space use native window dragging and double-click behavior, while preserving tab selection and inline rename.
### 简体中文
- 使用原生 40 pt 紧凑单行顶部栏；侧边栏开关位于窗口控制按钮旁，新建文档与置顶按钮和文档标签保持对齐。 - 文档标签统一为 168 pt 宽、30 pt 高，使用 13 pt 常规字重标题和更轻的分隔线轮廓，保留与编辑区相连的台阶造型。 - 将文档文件夹选择移入设置，移除侧边栏头部的文件夹操作菜单。 - 统一侧边栏文件行高，并让选中标签与其连接的内容区域保持相同背景色。 - 使用 TextKit 2 修复编辑显示，插入或删除文字后不再残留旧行片段；自动换行行号、末行与搜索高亮保持和显示文字对齐。 - 调整窗口大小时同步更新标签栏可用宽度，放大窗口后能显示更多标签，不再留下无法利用的空白。 - 顶部栏空白区域交还系统处理拖窗与双击，同时保留标签选择和行内重命名。

# NeatEditor 1.0.15
### Changed
- Require macOS 26.0 or later and Xcode 26.0 or later to build. Keep universal Apple silicon and Intel packages; CI validates with Xcode 26.0.1 on macOS 26. - Use the macOS 26 native prominent toolbar style while Always on Top is enabled. - Replace deprecated SwiftUI text concatenation with a complete localizable sentence and styled shortcut interpolation.
### Fixed
- Keep the selected tab's filename, fill and outline together during rapid window resizing and overflow scrolling. Resize no longer queues competing reveal animations. - Shift+Enter now inserts at the logical content end without splitting CRLF or overlooking Unicode line terminators. The insertion still supports native undo. Line numbers now count the same native line boundaries, including the final empty line.
### 简体中文
- 最低系统版本提高到 macOS 26.0，构建要求 Xcode 26.0 或更新版本；继续提供 Apple silicon 和 Intel 通用安装包，CI 改用 macOS 26 与 Xcode 26.0.1。 - 置顶启用时使用 macOS 26 原生工具栏强调样式，清楚显示当前状态。 - 用完整句子的本地化插值替换已废弃的 SwiftUI 文本拼接，保留快捷键的加粗显示。 - 修复快速调整窗口大小和溢出滚动时，标签文件名、底色与轮廓各自移动的问题；缩放不再叠加相互竞争的滚动动画。 - 修复 Shift+Enter 拆开 CRLF 或漏判 Unicode 换行符的问题；插入操作仍可原生撤销，行号也按相同的原生换行边界计数（包含末尾空行）。

# NeatEditor 1.0.14
### Fixed
- The native Sidebar toolbar button no longer draws a blue focus ring after accessibility or keyboard activation. Rounded stepped tabs, the continuous editor join, folder selection and window dragging are unchanged.
### 简体中文
- 修复通过辅助功能或键盘激活原生侧边栏按钮后出现蓝色焦点圈的问题；保留圆角台阶标签、连续底边、文件夹切换及拖窗优化。

# NeatEditor 1.0.13
### Fixed
- The selected tab's outline now meets the editor's top rule on the same line, so the tab bar border stays continuous instead of breaking at the tab's bottom corners. - The tab join is measured from AppKit window frames, so the line stays aligned when the sidebar is shown, hidden, or resized.
### 简体中文
- 选中标签的轮廓与编辑区顶线落在同一条线上，标签栏边框不再在标签底部两角断开。 - 标签开口改用 AppKit 窗口坐标换算，侧边栏显示、隐藏或拖动宽度时仍保持对齐。

# NeatEditor 1.0.12
### Changed
- The sidebar lists your `~/Documents` folder by default and can switch to another folder from its header. New documents save to the current folder, and the choice is remembered across launches. - Files without an extension are listed when their head looks like plain UTF-8 text, so extensionless notes appear while binaries are still skipped. - Sidebar rows no longer draw a file icon, giving filenames and previews the full width of the narrow sidebar. - The toolbar's tab strip and the editor share one continuous top rule that opens under the selected tab, keeping the tab attached to the page.
### Fixed
- Documents left in the previous app library (`~/.config/neateditor/documents`) are copied into the current folder once, without overwriting or deleting anything.
### 简体中文
- 侧边栏默认列出你的 `~/Documents`，可在头部切换到其它文件夹；新文档保存到当前文件夹，选择会在重启后保留。 - 无扩展名文件在开头内容像 UTF-8 纯文本时会显示，因此无扩展名笔记也能列出，二进制文件仍然跳过。 - 侧边栏行不再显示文件图标，文件名和摘要可使用窄栏的全部宽度。 - 工具栏下的标签栏与编辑区共用一条连续顶线，并在选中标签处留出开口，让标签与页面保持相连。 - 旧应用目录（`~/.config/neateditor/documents`）中的文档会一次性复制到当前文件夹，不覆盖、不删除任何文件。

# NeatEditor 1.0.9
### Changed
- Remove Text Softness and its three sliders from Settings. Existing document appearance is preserved. - Reduce the Settings content minimum to 500 × 440 points; all remaining controls fit without scrolling.
### 简体中文
- 从设置中移除文字柔和度及其三个滑块，保留现有文档显示效果。 - 设置内容最小尺寸缩小为 500 × 440 点，剩余控件完整可见，无需滚动。

# NeatEditor 1.0.8
## 1.0.8 - 2026-10-18
### Changed
- Settings uses a compact native grouped form with aligned controls, switches and app information. It remains a workspace tab. - Adjust text softness for light, dark and high-contrast appearances with native percentage sliders; existing preferences and immediate application are preserved. - Settings has a 500 × 600 point content minimum so all controls remain visible in smaller windows.
### 简体中文
- 设置改为紧凑的原生分组表单，统一对齐控件、开关和应用信息，继续保留在工作区标签中。 - 浅色、深色和高对比度外观的文字柔和度可用系统滑块按百分比调整，沿用现有偏好并即时生效。 - 设置的内容最小尺寸为 500 × 600 点，较小的窗口也能完整显示全部控件。

# NeatEditor 1.0.7
- Update package is Sparkle EdDSA-signed, Developer ID-signed and notarized by Apple. - 更新包经过 Sparkle EdDSA 签名、Developer ID 签名与苹果公证。
